name: claude-browser
description: A live browser inside VS Code and Cursor, shared with Claude Code: you and Claude see and drive the same tab. Pick elements into the prompt, verify changes after hot reload, measure, fill forms, test every screen size.

commands.title: Claude Browser: Side by Side (mobile, tablet, desktop)
Claude Browser: Restart Cursor with Browser Control
Claude Browser: Register MCP Server with Claude Code

claudeBrowser.port.description: Local port of the shared browser engine (also used by the MCP server).

claudeBrowser.homeUrl.description: URL opened when the browser starts with nothing to restore. Empty shows the start page, which lists the dev servers running on this machine and recent pages.

claudeBrowser.onPick.description: What picking an element does: add a short pick card (what the element is, where it is on the page, its source line when known) to the Claude Code prompt as an @-mentioned file, copy the card, or both. Claude fetches more detail with browser_inspect only when the task needs it.

claudeBrowser.nodePath.description: Node.js used to run the browser engine (auto-detected when empty).

enumDescriptions: Use Claude Browser's own Chromium (downloaded once, about 200 MB, into ~/.claude-browser/chromium). An installed browser is only used while that download runs.
Use the Chrome, Edge or Brave installed on this machine and never download one.
Headless Chrome streamed into a panel inside the editor (side-by-side view, custom popups).
Chrome as its own visible window next to the editor: drawn natively, always sharp, no streaming. Pick with ⌥⇧P in the page or “Claude Browser: Pick Element”; picks still go to the Claude prompt.

Cursor's own built-in Browser Tab, inside the editor: drawn natively by Cursor, driven by Claude over CDP. Needs Cursor started with --remote-debugging-port=9333 (“Claude Browser: Restart Cursor with Browser Control” does that).
claudeBrowser.mode.description: Where the shared browser is shown. Changing it restarts the browser.

claudeBrowser.chromePath.description: Path to a specific Chromium-based browser executable. Overrides claudeBrowser.browser.
